notes: Single frame; no metadata or alternate angle.
Could contain platform capture or external color grading.

evidence: Vertical architecture edges remain nearly parallel.
Foreground fixtures have moderate perspective expansion rather than an ultra-wide stretch.
observations.inference: Use a normal-to-moderately-wide gameplay FOV hypothesis before tuning lighting.
alternatives: Screenshot may be cropped from a wider original.
observations.next_view: An uncropped frame from the same camera path.

evidence: Unlit upper walls remain cool and dim.
No strong parallel outdoor cast shadows are visible.
observations.inference: Use weak cool environment fill and let motivated local fixtures define the scene.
alternatives: A moon key may exist outside the frame.
confounders: Dark base-color textures can imitate weak fill.
observations.next_view: A wider exterior view showing rooflines and open sky.

evidence: Occlusion around crates is readable but edge direction changes near different fixtures.
No single dominant sun-shadow vector explains the frame.
observations.inference: Local lights dominate shadow structure; global shadow softness is secondary.
alternatives: Some apparent shadows may be baked into textures.
observations.next_view: A moving frame showing whether shadow edges respond to characters.

evidence: Neon cores approach white but retain some hue.
Dark wall detail remains visible without lifting the whole frame.
observations.inference: Use slightly negative exposure with moderate contrast; avoid crushing shadows through global contrast alone.
alternatives: The image may have been tone-mapped outside Roblox.
observations.next_view: A raw in-client capture with a neutral gray object in frame.

evidence: Only a narrow dark-blue sky strip is visible; no cloud silhouette is readable.
observations.inference: Use a dark compatible sky and leave dynamic Clouds disabled until stronger evidence exists.
alternatives: The sky strip may be a backdrop mesh rather than a Sky.
observations.next_view: An upward-looking frame from the same map.

evidence: Far end of alley loses contrast and shifts cool blue.
observations.inference: Use moderate cool Atmosphere density/haze to separate depth without fogging the near route.
alternatives: Depth loss may come from a translucent fog plane or post effect.
observations.next_view: A side view with known-distance repeated objects.

evidence: Cyan spill is strongest near a wall sign and decays across adjacent floor surfaces.
Magenta spill is broad and directional near a panel on the opposite wall.
observations.inference: Use a cyan PointLight or small SurfaceLight plus a broad magenta SurfaceLight attached to visible fixtures.
alternatives: The cyan source could be two lower-range lights rather than one.
observations.next_view: A frame showing the fixture and receiving floor in one unobstructed view.

evidence: Bright sign strokes produce a soft halo beyond their geometry.
Nearby walls also show colored spill, so bloom alone cannot explain the effect.
observations.inference: Combine Neon/emissive-looking source geometry, real local light spill, and thresholded moderate bloom.
alternatives: A custom glow texture may contribute to the halo.
confounders: Image resizing can create false halos.
observations.next_view: A native-resolution crop of the sign edge.

evidence: Wet-looking floor carries elongated colored highlights but rough walls do not.
observations.inference: Material roughness/normal response is essential; use high environment specular only after matching floor material maps.
alternatives: Highlights may be painted into the floor texture.
observations.next_view: A camera move across the floor to see whether highlights parallax.

evidence: Overall shadows lean blue while local accents remain saturated.
No obvious gameplay-wide depth blur is visible.
observations.inference: Use a restrained cool tint and saturation lift; do not add global depth of field.
alternatives: The cast may come mainly from sky/environment fill.
observations.next_view: A neutral indoor object lit only by ambient fill.

evidence: The central walkable strip is brighter than side recesses and exits converge toward a cool focal patch.
observations.inference: Preserve route value contrast and keep interactables readable without relying on bloom color alone.
alternatives: The screenshot may be staged rather than representative gameplay.
confounders: No UI or player avatar visible
observations.next_view: A normal gameplay frame with avatar, UI, hazards, and interactables.

hypotheses.summary: Cool low global fill, moderate blue atmosphere, cyan/magenta motivated local fixtures, wet PBR floor, restrained thresholded bloom.
assumptions: The screenshot is close to raw gameplay output.
Floor highlights are materially responsive rather than painted.
rejected_if: Additional frames show static painted light pools with no parallax or character shadow response.

hypotheses.summary: Flatter ambient scene with much of the neon look baked into textures and a stronger external color grade.
assumptions: The image is promotional or externally graded.
rejected_if: Video shows dynamic light spill and moving shadows from the fixtures.

limitations: One image cannot identify exact Roblox properties, hidden lights, camera exposure, or runtime quality level.
World scale, material maps, sky assets, camera FOV/crop, and external editing are unknown.
The reference may use baked textures, custom meshes, or effects not reproducible exactly with Roblox built-ins.
